elements.description:
A row of avatars for people and accounts – a gradient ring when there's something new, a gray ring once seen – and
the modal "what changed" brief each one opens: a bento grid of update tiles, with Previous and Next between entries.

properties.name: entries
properties.description: The people and accounts, in the order the row shows them; entries with no updates are left out

properties.name: seen
properties.description: The update ids that have been seen, as a Set or a record of id → true; the app owns it

properties.name: open
properties.description: The id of the entry whose brief is open, or null when it's closed

properties.name: addable
properties.description: Show the "add" tile first in the row

properties.name: addLabel
properties.description: The "add" tile's text

properties.name: addAvatar
properties.description: An image for the "add" tile (the person's own avatar); without one it shows a plus

properties.name: replyable
properties.description: Show a reply field at the foot of the brief; sending fires tc-reply

properties.name: label
properties.description: The row's accessible name

properties.name: newLabel
properties.description: Said after a name when there's something new ("Maya Chen, 2 new")

properties.name: seenLabel
properties.description: Said after a name when everything's been seen ("Maya Chen, seen")

properties.name: markerLabel
properties.description: The marker on a tile that's new since the last look

properties.name: describeCount
properties.description: The header's count line, from the number of new updates and of all of them; `since` follows it after " · "

properties.name: generatedLabel
properties.description: The mark on a summary the app says was generated

properties.name: betterLabel
properties.description: Said after a metric's change when it's the good direction

properties.name: worseLabel
properties.description: Said after a metric's change when it's the bad direction

properties.name: toLabel
properties.description: Said between a status move's two states ("Draft to In review")

properties.name: moreLabel
properties.description: After the count of a list's hidden items ("+3 more")

properties.name: emptyLabel
properties.description: Shown when there are no entries and no "add" tile

properties.name: replyLabel
properties.description: The reply field's placeholder and name, before the entry's name ("Reply to Maya Chen")

properties.name: sendLabel
properties.description: The send button's name

properties.name: closeLabel
properties.description: The close button's name

properties.name: previousLabel
properties.description: The word over the previous entry's name

properties.name: nextLabel
properties.description: The word over the next entry's name

properties.name: people
properties.description: The same list as `entries`, by its earlier name

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: A brief is opening, moving to another entry or closing ({ open }: StoryOpenChangeEvent – the entry id, or null); cancelable – prevented, `open` stays as it was

events.name: tc-seen-change
events.description: A brief was opened on unseen updates, once per opening ({ seen, entry, updates }: StorySeenChangeEvent – `seen` with every one of them added, in the same shape); cancelable – prevented, `seen` stays as it was

events.name: tc-action
events.description: A link or action tile was activated ({ entry, update }: StoryActionEvent); cancelable – prevented, a link doesn't navigate

events.name: tc-reply
events.description: A reply was sent from the brief ({ text, entry }: StoryReplyEvent)

events.name: tc-add
events.description: The "add" tile was activated; detail: undefined

cssProperties.name: --tc-story-ring
cssProperties.value: conic-gradient(from 210deg, var(--tc-tone-amber-solid), var(--tc-tone-rose-solid), var(--tc-tone-pink-solid), var(--tc-tone-violet-solid), var(--tc-tone-amber-solid))

props.name: entries
props.description: The people and accounts, in the order the row shows them

props.name: people
props.description: The same list as `entries`, by its earlier name

props.name: seen
props.description: The update ids that have been seen – controlled when given

props.name: defaultSeen
props.description: The seen update ids on mount when `seen` isn't controlled

props.name: onSeenChange
props.type: (seen: StorySeen, updates: StoryUpdate[], entry: StoryEntry) => void
props.description: A brief was opened on unseen updates: `seen` is the set (or record) with all of them added

props.name: open
props.description: The id of the entry whose brief is open, or null when closed – controlled when given

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The entry open on mount when `open` isn't controlled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The brief is opening, moving to another entry, or closing (null)

props.name: onAction
props.type: (update: StoryLinkUpdate, entry: StoryEntry, event: Event) => void
props.description: A link or action tile was activated; call `event.preventDefault()` to stop a link navigating

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Shows the "add" tile first in the row; called when it's activated

props.name: onReply
props.description: Shows a reply field at the brief's foot; called with the text when a reply is sent

changelog: **Shared code:** - `internal/modal.ts`, the `ModalController` that `tc-dialog`, `tc-terms-dialog` and `tc-stories` share; - `cardHead()` gains `picture`, `pictureShape` and `keepAside`.

**`tc-stories`:** opens a "what changed" brief instead of a story player. - **The row stays:** the gradient ring still means something new. - **The brief:** a light modal with an optional summary, then a bento of update tiles (metric, status move, note, list, image, link), new ones first. Previous and Next move between entries. - **Entries:** `entries`, which can be people or accounts; `people` still works. - **Removed:** the timers, video and swipe.
**Feedback and onboarding:** - `tc-stories`: a gradient ring for new updates that opens a modal viewer; - `tc-background-tasks`.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: <dialog> and showModal()
features.why: Modals trap focus, close on Escape and sit in the top layer.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-color
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default colours.

features.name: text-wrap: pretty
features.without: Paragraphs may end on a single short word.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
